items.title: Public Preview: ECMP Nexthop
items.description:
Equal-Cost Multi-Path (ECMP) routing for Azure Virtual Network is now available in public preview, enabling customers to distribute traffic across multiple network appliances using a single user-defined route (UDR). 

Customers can configure 2 to 16 next-hop IP addresses per route, scaling aggregate network throughput beyond individual appliance limits without increasing routing complexity. This capability supports bandwidth-intensive AI workloads, large-scale data platforms, and enterprise hub-and-spoke architectures. 

Learn more.

items.title: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 in Azure Functions ends on September 1, 2027
items.description:
Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 on Azure Functions is ending on September 1, 2027. Your apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service for Java 8, 11 and 17. 

Required action

To avoid potential security vulnerabilities, minimize risk for your Azure Functions apps, and take advantage of latest features, follow the steps to upgrade your Function app to Java 25 before September 1, 2027.

Learn more.
